text: GraphQL-based public API that returns exactly the data you request in a structured format
quote: The Fireflies API is built on top of GraphQL... This API allows you to retrieve exactly the data you need in a structured format.

text: Users can get their own API key from the Integrations section of their account
quote: Follow these steps to obtain your API key for the Fireflies API: 1. Log in to your account... 4. Copy and store your API key securely

text: API requests are authorized with a bearer token in the Authorization header
quote: We use a standard bearer token authentication mechanism. This means that to make authorized requests to the API, you must include an `Authorization` header with a valid token.

text: uploadAudio API mutation uploads audio files to Fireflies for transcription
quote: The `uploadAudio` mutation allows you to upload audio files to Fireflies.ai for transcription.

text: API query fetches a list of transcripts filtered by input arguments
quote: The transcripts query is designed to fetch a list of transcripts against input arguments.

text: API query fetches the details of a specific transcript by ID
quote: The transcript query is designed to fetch details associated with a specific transcript ID.

text: API can filter meetings by attendee email addresses
quote: Filter meetings that contain any of these emails as attendees. Accepts an array of email addresses.

text: Uploads can set the actual meeting start time so imported historical recordings are dated correctly
quote: Use it when importing historical recordings so the meeting is dated with the actual meeting start time instead of the upload time.

text: Documentation MCP server lets AI tools search and retrieve Fireflies documentation
quote: The Fireflies Documentation MCP Server enables AI tools to search and retrieve information directly from the Fireflies documentation.

text: A downloadable docs file can be given to AI coding tools to analyze and debug integration code
quote: Upload the downloaded file to your AI coding tool. Instruct your tool to analyze and debug the code using the content of this file.

text: Connect Fireflies to ChatGPT through OAuth, with no API key, and query meeting data via Deep Research
quote: You can now connect Fireflies to ChatGPT using our OAuth integration—no API keys required.

text: Fireflies MCP server connects AI tools directly to your meeting data
quote: The Fireflies MCP Server enables AI tools to connect directly to your meeting data without switching platforms or copying transcript excerpts.

text: MCP tools include read-only queries and actions such as sharing meetings and creating soundbites
quote: some are read-only while others allow you to take actions like sharing meetings or creating soundbites.

text: Share meeting transcripts with up to 100 email recipients, with an optional expiry
quote: fireflies_share_meeting - Share meeting transcripts with up to 100 email recipients, with optional expiry

text: Move meetings into a channel or folder, up to 5 at a time
quote: fireflies_move_meeting - Move meetings to a channel/folder (up to 5 at a time)

text: Create soundbite clips from a meeting transcript
quote: fireflies_create_soundbite - Create a soundbite clip from a meeting transcript

text: Notetaker bot can be invited to live meetings or auto-join calendar meetings to record, transcribe and summarize
quote: Invite fred@fireflies.ai to a live meeting or have it autojoin your calendar meetings to record, transcribe, and summarize.

text: Works with Zoom, Google Meet, Teams and other meeting platforms
quote: Zoom, GMeet, Teams, +more ... Transcription in 100+ languages

text: Real-time notes and live transcription during meetings, such as Google Meet calls
quote: Automatically record your Google Meet calls and get real-time transcripts.

text: Detailed notes, action items and customized summaries delivered right after every meeting
quote: Get detailed notes, action items, and customized summaries instantly after every meeting.

text: Multi-language mode switches transcription language automatically from meeting to meeting
quote: Automatically switch languages from meeting to meeting with ease.

text: Transcription in more than 100 languages
quote: Zoom, GMeet, Teams, +more ... Transcription in 100+ languages

text: Identifies different speakers in meetings and audio files
quote: Fireflies identifies different speakers in meetings and audio files.

text: Audit logs available, including through an audit events API
quote: Audit Logs ([API](https://docs.fireflies.ai/graphql-api/query/audit-events#audit-events))

text: Rules engine gives admins automation workflows that control meeting access and privacy
quote:
Rules Engine

Automation workflows for admins to have control over meeting access and privacy.

text: GraphQL introspection lets you query the server to discover its schema
quote: Introspection is a feature that allows querying a GraphQL server to discover its schema.

text: Built-in Apollo Sandbox for exploring and running queries against the API
quote: For introspection using our builtin Apollo Sandbox, visit api.fireflies.ai/graphql and enter your api_key in the Headers section as a Bearer token

text: Code snippet examples and replits for interacting with the API
quote: Explore a wide array of examples where we have created code snippets that allows you to interact with the Fireflies API.

text: AskFred AI assistant answers natural-language questions about one meeting or across many meetings
quote: Query individual meetings or search across multiple meetings to get intelligent, context-aware answers.

text: AskFred keeps context across follow-up questions in a conversation
quote: Maintain conversations where follow-up questions preserve context from previous exchanges

text: Cross-call analysis, such as comparing objections raised by Enterprise vs SMB prospects
quote: Compare the objections mentioned in calls with Enterprise prospects versus SMB prospects this quarter

text: Conversation intelligence and team analytics for admins
quote:
Conversation intelligence

Team analytics (for admins)

text: Analytics API query returns conversation and meeting metrics for teams and users over a date range
quote: The analytics query fetches detailed conversation and meeting metrics for teams and users across a specified date range.

text: Search meetings by keywords in the title and/or words spoken in the meeting
quote: Allows searching for keywords in meeting title and/or words spoken during the meeting

text: Enterprise private storage keeps meeting data in your preferred location on dedicated cloud storage
quote: Private Storage on Enterprise to store your meeting data at your preferred location.

text: 0-day data retention policy with all vendors and partners
quote: Private Storage options, 0-day data retention policy with all vendors and partners.

text: Super Admin can bypass team privacy settings to access and query all team meeting data
quote: The Super Admin functionality allows you to bypass your team's privacy settings, allowing you to query all data in your team's account.

text: Webhook sends notifications when transcription completes
quote: URL for the webhook that receives notifications when transcription completes

text: Super Admin webhook notifies on all meetings owned by the team for workflow automation
quote: A Super Admin webhook notifies you of all team meetings owned by your team, allowing you to automate workflows

text: Fireflies webhooks connect to Zapier to fetch transcripts automatically when meetings are processed
quote: Connect Fireflies webhooks to Zapier to automatically fetch transcripts when meetings are processed.

text: API query lists currently active meetings so you can monitor ongoing team meetings
quote: The active_meetings query is designed to fetch a list of meetings that are currently active (in progress).

text: Query questions asked by external, non-organization meeting participants
quote: This replit allows you to query questions asked by participants who do not belong to your organization.

text: API errors flagged friendly are safe to show to frontend clients
quote: `friendly === true` are safe to show to the frontend client.

text: Developer program participants get premium features, Business tier access and higher rate limits
quote: Participants will gain access to premium features and higher rate limits, ensuring a swift and successful project development.
